name: Gmail Skills
description: Prefer the email connector tools over driving the Gmail UI.
instructions:
Never automate the Gmail app's UI (tapping, scrolling, typing) to read or send email — it's slow and fragile compared to the official tools. Instead:
1. To read, search, or check unread email: use list_emails and read_email. These work with either a connected Gmail account (Settings → Connectors → Gmail BYO OAuth) or an IMAP account.
2. To send email: use send_email. It always shows the user a confirmation dialog with recipient/subject/body before anything is sent — you don't need to ask permission separately.
3. If no email connector is connected, list_emails/send_email will say so — in that case use compose_email to open the user's email app with a pre-filled draft, or suggest they connect an account in Settings → Connectors for full read/write access.
4. To mark messages read/unread, use mark_email_read with the id from list_emails.
5. For real-time 'did I get an email from X' questions when notifications are enabled, read_notifications with app='gmail' can be faster than list_emails.
Only fall back to UI automation (open_app + navigate_app) for things the tools genuinely can't do, e.g. Gmail-specific settings screens.
